zh: 金管局與Swift合作推動代幣化存款
探索與Ensemble項目互通提升跨境效率
中銀渣打滙豐參與探討多幣種應用
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) is enhancing its collaboration with Swift to explore using tokenized deposits to boost cross-border transaction efficiency. Working alongside major banks including Bank of China (Hong Kong), Standard Chartered Hong Kong, and HSBC, the initiative explores interoperability between Swift's ledger and Project Ensemble's settlement layer to advance multi-currency tokenized deposit frameworks.
work.title: 金管局與Swift合作探討運用代幣化存款提升跨境交易效率

zh: 陳茂波指國際資金正尋求多元配置
香港前九月存款增長近百分之八
科技企業佔新股集資額逾半
work.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan highlighted at the Bloomberg Global Regulatory Forum that global capital is seeking diversified allocations, particularly rebalancing toward Asia. He noted that Hong Kong bank deposits grew 7.7% to nearly HK$21 trillion in the first nine months of the year, while tech companies accounted for over half of IPO funds raised.
work.title: 陳茂波：市場正尋求多元配置

zh: WeLab Bank委任梁永祥出任行政總裁
接替已卸任的李家達即時生效
梁永祥擁有逾三十年亞洲金融經驗
work.en: WeLab Bank has appointed Ernest Leung as its Chief Executive with immediate effect as the bank enters its seventh year. He succeeds Tat Lee, who has stepped down from his executive role and the Board of Directors. Leung brings over 30 years of experience across the banking and finance sectors in Asia.
work.title: Ernest Leung Is WeLab Bank’s Fourth Chief Executive Since 2018

work.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) will introduce a new digital payment solution on December 14, 2026, for advance margin deposits. Building on its exploration of the e-HKD, the solution will serve eligible clearing participants of HKFE Clearing Corporation Limited during the After-Hours Trading session.
work.title: HKEX Builds on e-HKD Exploration with New Payment Solution

smalltalk_hk.headline: Johnson & Johnson Agrees to Acquire Ollin Biosciences for Up to $3.33 Billion
smalltalk_hk.body: Healthcare giant Johnson & Johnson has agreed to acquire biotechnology firm Ollin Biosciences in a deal valued at up to $3.33 billion to expand its pharmaceutical portfolio. The acquisition deal was first reported by the Financial Times before official confirmation.

smalltalk_hk.headline: US Futures Slip as Markets Await Nvidia Earnings and Anthropic IPO
smalltalk_hk.body: US stock index futures drifted lower in pre-market trading as investors adopted a cautious stance ahead of major market catalysts. Traders are focusing on Nvidia's upcoming financial results and Anthropic's initial public offering following a volatile week in tech stocks.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Steering Committee Holds First Meeting on Wang Fuk Court Fire Reforms
smalltalk_hk.body: The steering committee led by Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki held its first meeting to advance building repair reforms following recommendations from an independent inquiry into the Tai Po fire. The committee reviewed proposed safety measures and oversight frameworks to improve residential building maintenance.

smalltalk_hk.headline: European Union Approves UniCredit Acquisition of Commerzbank
smalltalk_hk.body: European Union regulatory authorities have formally granted approval for Italian lender UniCredit to proceed with its acquisition of Germany's Commerzbank. The decision marks a major step forward in European banking consolidation.

smalltalk_sg.body: A man in Singapore served 14 days in jail after being caught smuggling a Pomeranian puppy from Malaysia as a Christmas present for his fiancée. Authorities also uncovered unauthorized rare animals kept at his home during the investigation.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Indonesian President Apologizes to Singapore and Malaysia over Transboundary Haze
smalltalk_sg.body: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto issued a formal apology to Singapore and Malaysia at the ASEAN summit in Manila regarding the prolonged transboundary haze caused by forest fires. He reiterated Indonesia's commitment to zero-burning policies following the intense four-month fire season.

juicy_hk.headline: 蔡天鳳案助逃案女被告上訴遭駁回 即時服刑半年
juicy_hk.body: 網紅潘巧賢因協助蔡天鳳案被告鄺港智意圖潛逃，早前被裁定罪成判監六個月。她就定罪及刑罰提出上訴，高院高等法院審理後決定駁回上訴，被告須即時入獄服刑。

juicy_hk.headline: 前元朗區議員涉與未成年少女發生性行為 上訴定罪與刑期
juicy_hk.body: 39歲前元朗區議員施駿興因與未滿16歲少女非法發生性行為，早前被判囚兩年半。被告已向高等法院提出上訴申請，就定罪及判刑尋求推翻原判。

juicy_hk.headline: 警隊全面啟動CCTV人臉識別系統 澄清不會濫用技術
juicy_hk.body: 香港警隊宣佈配合40億港元數碼監控拓展計畫，正式在人工智能CCTV網絡啟用人臉識別功能。警務處處長蕭澤頤受訪時保證有關技術將嚴格按法例執行，絕不會被濫用。

juicy_hk.headline: 內地規範青少年體育培訓機構安全與合規要求
juicy_hk.body: 內地本月起正式實施新法規，加強對青少年體育培訓機構的場地安全及師資合規監管。官方媒體報道指出，新措施旨在保障學員安全並促進行業健康發展。

juicy_sg.headline: Over $1,700 Spent on Electronics Expo Items Left Pending After Seller Cut Contact
juicy_sg.body: A homeowner who paid over $1,700 for a water filter and electric clothes rack at a local electronics expo experienced repeated delivery delays before the seller completely stopped responding to calls and texts.

juicy_sg.headline: Woman Jailed for Abandoning 71 Cats in Public Housing Unit
juicy_sg.body: A Singapore court sentenced a woman to prison after a joint NParks and police probe revealed she had abandoned 71 cats in a flat without power or water, causing nine felines to perish.

juicy_sg.headline: Nvidia-Megaspeed Export Control Probe Raises Concerns Over Singapore Tech Sector
juicy_sg.body: Investigators in Singapore are scrutinizing tech firm Megaspeed over multi-billion dollar Nvidia chip deals linked to front companies and alleged export restriction evasions. Industry analysts warn the probe could complicate business transactions and heighten US regulatory scrutiny on local firms.

juicy_sg.headline: Global Open Letter Demands Reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
juicy_sg.body: An online petition urging Nvidia to restore Jensen Huang as CEO has gathered over 130,000 signatures following his sudden departure. High-profile figures including Elon Musk and Tom Lee have publicly backed the campaign.
